scope: entire island in three growing states; all five world layers

crop.sequence: three equal square crops; same fixed camera

candidates.name: 入り江を囲む、森と港の島
candidates.idea: 入り江を軸に、森の集落・花の庭・水辺の街区が曲線でつながる。
candidates.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. A beautiful comprehensive GAME WORLD art board for the ENTIRE growing Sansu island, not a tree asset, one forest attraction, or a finished backdrop with tiny props sprinkled around.
Output a wide horizontal TRIPTYCH, three equal square panels with very thin white gutters and absolutely no text, UI or arrows. Every panel is a COMPLETE island seen from exactly the same fixed orthographic three-quarter camera with the same zoom, lighting, sea, original starting home and original land location. LEFT: early island. MIDDLE: developing whole island. RIGHT: richly mature expanded island. Each square is a real 390x388 mobile island art viewport; show full shore, all tall canopy tops and all district grounding with sea margins in every panel. Treat the right scene as a complete connected game world with several distinctive grown places and genuine living districts, with a clear composed silhouette and meaningful open areas.
Reference roles: image1 existing Sansu initial screenshot supplies the sunny bright clear-blue sea, soft rounded toy-scale 3D, familiar patchwork-roof cottage and blue door; ignore interface. Image2 Little Habitats sample supplies ONLY island-wide spatial grammar: indented rounded coast, gentle terraces, connected footpaths and water, distinct planted areas becoming place-scale forms. Do NOT copy its assets, temple, torii, landmarks, vegetation shapes or UI. Image3 original Pokomoko portrait fixes resident identity: asymmetric cream-left/blue-right face, cream muzzle, tiny black bead eyes, black spotted round left ear and pink spotted round right ear, multicolor patchwork torso/limbs, red scarf. Use tiny residents with these visible color masses, no invented generic mascot, no giant eyes, no character redesign.
Shared evolution: the original cozy one-story cottage near the lower/front-left is identifiable in ALL three panels, with identical roof colors, blue doorway, dimensions and original ground beneath. No existing home, land or resident disappears. Initial island is already charming, small organic rounded shoreline, several saplings, a flower cluster and 1 resident. Whole world expands OUTWARD as new gently rounded low-terraced districts arise, preserving original land and home, not reshaping the original floor out from under it. Middle has several homes with beginnings of connected courtyards, growing plants forming partial rooms, water route and bridges being connected. Mature has 9-12 small homes in THREE spatially separate but coherently connected neighborhoods; population number is illustrative, not a limit or game threshold. House appearance matures visibly with broader joined shared footing, taller modest rounded gables, verandas, a few two-story forms, coherent roof groups and shared courts, while original home remains recognizable. Preserve distinct owned homes rather than consuming them into a mansion. Some roof colors are cobalt, coral and yellow, related to original patchwork, without identical rainbow cottages everywhere.
FIVE WHOLE-WORLD LAYERS must evolve together: 1 softly irregular land and shore grows into coves/peninsulas/low rounded terraces; 2 coherent blue flowing water and reachable empty paths/bridges link places; 3 multiple plant types form broad canopy rooms, flowering garden boundaries and meadow color masses; 4 houses evolve into living neighborhood silhouettes, shared plazas and clear entrances facing them; 5 fairy-tale wonder emerges from the connection of these places as larger organic architecture and scale contrast, visible in DAYLIGHT.
Make the mature render feel extraordinarily fantastical and inviting, not an ordinary park. Several planted tree clusters collectively become asymmetric arches, high airy canopies and shaded neighborhood rooms, with MULTIPLE rooted trunks visibly generating their structures. A different flowering grove becomes a sweeping living garden enclosure; flower masses become a walkable meadow/garden rather than more pots. Across the world, branches, banks and shared building footings relate and connect. There must be several different large forms across the whole island; no single huge central tree explaining all the fantasy. An evolving market/common house made from the SAME town architecture can ground one court, not an unrelated ornamental landmark. Every large change has a small precursor already present in the left or middle stage. Residents visibly walk, gather, sit in shade, or cross bridges between districts; all feet grounded.
Style: polished warm playful believable real-time stylized THREE-DIMENSIONAL game render, deliberately rounded sculptural volumes and soft chamfers, crisp coherent major forms, mild tactile surface finish. Painted wood, smooth thick earthen grass-topped shores, matte cottage plaster, thick rounded roof pieces, grouped velvety leaves and clean shallow water have different material responses. Delightful storybook toy-diorama art, no watercolor/flat illustration, no photoreal dense micro foliage. Bright midday sun, soft contact shadows and readable interior shade, clean sky-blue surrounding sea and neutral sunlit ground; restrained fresh plant green, coral/ivory flowering masses, blue/pink/yellow roof accents. Do not grade the whole world dark green, teal, mustard or brass. Fantasy comes from shape, scale, built relationships, water and airy living spaces, not lamps, sparkles, crystals, floating rocks or generic magic symbols.
Composition continuity: choose a single framing that keeps the mature island fully inside its square and leaves sea around ALL edges. Original starting land is around 45 percent of the mature land area, early island therefore smaller but still readable; camera must NEVER zoom/recenter between stages. Enlarged island should occupy around 85 percent of the square at maturity. No cropped canopy, no closed dark tunnel, no severed limbs, no unsafe contacts. Protected mobile readable space, clear entrances and visible resident faces, architecture and tree silhouettes distinct in a small viewport. No scatter of benches, lamps, signs, balloons, fountains or trinkets. Mature whole terrain is not a flat rectangular carpet and not a row of independent item models. An ENTIRE island grows in space, shape, architecture, ecology and life.
Direction A / spatial plan: a beautiful rounded crescent/cupped-coast island surrounding a shallow blue sheltered inlet opening toward the front. Original cottage is on the lower-left starting shore. Middle expansion reaches around both sides of the inlet without moving the home. Mature rear-left rooted woodland arcade shelters a small forest neighborhood; right petal-like peninsula carries a coral/ivory flowering garden neighborhood; left/front shoreline carries a compact shared harbor-side court of rounded matured homes, broad coherent footings and approachable doorways. One or two modest timber bridges cross narrow inland water passages, not the wide open sea. The neighborhoods face different shared spaces but clearly connect by one winding readable route. Island-wide primary silhouette is the graceful embracing coast and joined living architecture framing water, not an individual giant tree. Keep the inlet open and airy and late vegetation organic, luminous and beautifully shaped.

candidates.idea: 低い丘と一本の水の流れに沿って、木陰・庭園・広場・家並みが育つ。
